fixed.how: New route POST /projects/:id/pull-requests/:number/close (docs-routes.ts, server.ts; 403 for another person's project, 400 for a bad number). It runs ProjectPullRequests.close (daemon/pull-requests.ts). This closes only a row of kind cancelled whose task is cancelled, with exactly one PATCH (state closed, no branch deleted), then settles the record through closedAtPress. A refused token, a token without write access and GitHub not answering each get one sentence (leaf daemon/pull-request-close-words.ts), and nothing is recorded. The Overview's cancelled rows get Close ("Closing…" while waiting; the answer or the refusal shows on the row). The fake daemon answers the route. Chat's facts line for such pull requests now names Close.
fixed.check_in_the_app: On a repository project, run two tasks so both pull requests wait. Redo one task, then cancel it. On the Overview, 'Cancelled, still open on GitHub' shows 'Its task was cancelled: close its pull request, or reopen the task in Tasks.' with Open and Close. Press Close. The row reads 'Closed #N on GitHub; you can reopen it there.' and the row is gone. On GitHub the pull request is closed and its branch is still there.

fixed.how: take-out.ts no longer refuses when there is no merge_sha. new_problems: W15-01's sole-linked rule: an unmarked open fr/docs-scaffold pull request of another project counts as this project's own when this project is the only one linked to the repository, so the scaffold (and Try again) writes onto it. Evidence: the real-daemon Try again case first wrote onto fr/docs-scaffold until Sandbox's PR body was marked with forerunnerMarker({project: SANDBOX_ID}); the rule is in loop/docs.ts scaffoldBranchFor.

After Close (or any pull request closed without merging), the Overview's Last result still says 'Left 2 reviewed pull requests for you to merge.' with no 'Since then' line for the closed one: mergedSinceLine handles merged records only. Evidence: /tmp/frbench/fix-l4-github-carried-evidence/run1/03-after-3-overview-closed.txt ('Left 2 reviewed pull requests for you to merge. Nothing left.' beside 'Closed #2 on GitHub; you can reopen it there.').
notes_for_other_areas: New route POST /projects/:id/pull-requests/:number/close (DAEMON_ROUTES.closePullRequest) answers PullRequestCloseAnswer {state: closed|refused, sentence, number}. Client: closePullRequest(projectId, number). Words are in the leaf daemon/pull-request-close-words.ts (CLOSE_PULL_REQUEST_EXPLAIN, pullRequestClosedSentence, closeNotOpenSentence, closeNotCancelledSentence, closeFailedSentence).

New route POST /projects/:id/take-over/retry (DAEMON_ROUTES.retryTakeOver) answers TakeOverRetryAnswer {state: opened|refused, sentence, prUrl}. Client: retryTakeOver(projectId). It is backed by daemon/take-over-retry.ts retryTakeOverDocs.

ProjectCard.repositoryElsewhere has optional outcome ('took_over_no_pull_request') and tryAgainLine. Use outcome to tell the take-over outcome line from OR-07's offer. L4e-left-5 (the intake's push outcome) should set the same outcome so the line and Try again are reused.
ProjectPullRequestView.rebuilt (optional boolean): a task row whose record's last_outcome is rebuilt_without. The Overview lists it under 'Rebuilt since the critic's review'.

RepositoryFacts.mergedThrough (optional): done tasks closed on GitHub whose change reached main through another's merge, each with {title, url, through}. filesBlock writes 'Closed, but its change reached main through #B: ...'.

Capabilities: branchSegment(text, fallback, max=40) is the one slug for task, intake-docs and scaffold branches. Git.mergeThatBrought(sha, into) finds the first-parent merge commit that brought sha in. takeOut's git result adds kind 'no_merge_commit', and pushed carries mergeSha.

UI: pages/project/TakeOverTryAgain.tsx (props projectId, line, testId, onOpened) renders <testId>-button, <testId>-line and <testId>-refused. The Overview's pull-request list is read again when the card's take-over outcome changes.
repoHostsFor: github.com is added only when no git remote base is set and the API base is not GitHub Enterprise's /api/v3 form. Stand-ins (http://127.0.0.1:port) keep github.com.

Fake daemon state: pullRequestCloses, pullRequestCloseFails ('proj#n' -> refused_token|no_access|unreachable), takeOverRetryFails (projectId -> refused|blocked). Its import refuses another host with 409 conflict, cause other_host.

The bench walk scripts (scratchpad walk-carried-close.cjs and walk-carried-retry.cjs) show how to plant a foreign marker on bench/empty and refuse pushes with a pre-receive hook in /tmp/frbench/<n>/githost/bench/empty.git.
